content.text: In regions where platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-explained-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-infrastructure-reality-2|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-creators-stripe-2|Stripe Alternatives]] and PayPal are inaccessible, deploying a digital store can feel impossible. This guide provides a clear pathway to set up your digital commerce infrastructure using Cloudflare Pages without relying on conventional payment processors. With [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-22|coremerch]]'s Stack 02, you can launch your online store efficiently and securely, ensuring your products reach customers without the usual barriers. Let’s dive into the steps required to get your store live, enabling crypto payments seamlessly.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors often lock out creators in developing regions, leaving them without viable options for digital sales. COREMERCH's infrastructure bypasses these limitations by providing a self-hosted solution. Using Stack 02, you gain full ownership of your digital store, ensuring that you do not rely on any third-party platform. This architecture is inherently robust, utilizing decentralized payment methods that align with the needs of creators operating in restrictive environments.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before beginning your deployment on Cloudflare Pages, ensure you have the necessary tools and accounts set up. You will need a Cloudflare account, access to Supabase for database management, and NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. Prepare your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, for upload. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which outlines the deployment process. This foundational preparation will streamline your deployment and ensure a smooth launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Configure your payment and delivery pipeline by integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages setup. Start by creating a NOWPayments account and obtaining your API key. Use Supabase to manage your product database, ensuring each transaction is recorded securely. Implement the delivery mechanism via Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of purchased digital products. This pipeline ensures seamless transactions and immediate access for customers, enhancing their purchasing experience.
Ownership of your infrastructure means full control over your sales.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your setup is complete, it’s time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site and conduct a test transaction to ensure everything functions as expected. Monitor the integration between NOWPayments and your backend to confirm that payment confirmations trigger product deliveries correctly. This initial transaction will validate your infrastructure and provide confidence in your setup. After confirming that all systems work, you can officially launch your store to the public.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store live, focus on scaling your operations. Begin by adding more products to your Supabase database and configuring them for sale on your site. Leverage Cloudflare’s robust performance features to optimize site speed and reliability. Consider utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations for improved email deliverability. Continuous monitoring and updates will ensure your store remains competitive and effective.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploying on Cloudflare Pages enhances performance and scalability.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Utilize COREMERCH's Stack 02, which combines Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. This setup allows you to host your store at no cost while securely processing crypto payments. Follow the deployment steps outlined in the Sovereign Blueprint for guidance.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, offering a more robust solution deployed in 48 hours. Stack 02 provides enhanced capabilities and support.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are viable hosting options for a digital product store. However, Cloudflare Pages offers superior performance and scalability, particularly when integrated with backend services like Supabase.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse customer base. This flexibility enables you to accept payments in various digital currencies, enhancing the accessibility of your store.
How long does it take to set up my store using COREMERCH?
Using Stack 02, your store can be fully deployed in 48 hours. This end-to-end tested deployment ensures that your infrastructure is robust and ready for operation once the handoff is complete.
